# Free VPN Russia

> Public GitHub aggregator of VPN configurations and setup documentation.

## Primary resources

- Repository: https://github.com/aviamastersgh/vpn-free-russia
- Recommended subscription: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aviamastersgh/vpn-free-russia/main/verified_configs.txt
- All configurations: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aviamastersgh/vpn-free-russia/main/all_configs.txt
- RU-oriented list: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aviamastersgh/vpn-free-russia/main/ru_configs.txt
- Quick Start: https://github.com/aviamastersgh/vpn-free-russia/blob/main/docs/quick-start.md
- AI reference: https://github.com/aviamastersgh/vpn-free-russia/blob/main/docs/ai/README.md

## Verification

`verified_configs.txt` means TCP endpoint reachability at update time.

It does not guarantee VPN handshake success, speed, stability, security, anonymity or regional availability.
